title: گل
description:
Ace identity is strictly locked to the reference image provided,transferring the face exactly, ra.
iPhone photo, vertical shot 9:16, medium shot from hip to head, angled at chest level, slight camera tilt, lively, imperfect composition.
scene in motion, head slightly tilted back,natural motion blur in hair and partially over shoulders, a sense of lightness and spontaneity. Hairstyle: cascade haircut, voluminous styling with a round brush, dense volume at the roots, soft curled ends, strands flying as she moves, one strand partially covers the face.
gazing off-camera, a lively, sincere expression holding a large bouquet of light-colored flowers wrapped in matte paper, a neat card with an inscription on the bouquet, ribbons hanging down.
clothing: short, structured brown dress-jacket with voluminous sleeves, mini length, small bag with a chain at the waist. dynamic pose, body slightly turned, arms hugging the bouquet, fabric  and a belt in gentle motion
